mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN order_type = 'LIMIT' AND price IS NOT NULL THEN price * original_qty WHEN quote_qty IS NOT NULL THEN quote_qty ELSE COALESCE(executed_quote, 0) END ), 0) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{dayStart} AND status <> 'REJECTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET executed_qty = COALESCE(executed_qty, 0) + #{executedQty}, executed_quote = COALESCE(executed_quote, 0) + #{executedQuote}, fee = COALESCE(fee, 0) + #{fee}, avg_fill_price = CASE WHEN COALESCE(executed_qty, 0) + #{executedQty} > 0 THEN (COALESCE(executed_quote, 0) + #{executedQuote}) / (COALESCE(executed_qty, 0) + #{executedQty}) ELSE avg_fill_price END, status = CASE WHEN #{filled} THEN 'FILLED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('NEW', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('NEW', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')
